description: React component for displaying and managing team members in a dashboard UI, including rendering a table with member details and actions.

methods.name: formatNumber
methods.description: Converts a number (possibly in scientific notation) to a human-readable string, formatted with commas and a fixed number of decimal places.

methods.name: getUserSpend
methods.description: Retrieves the total spend of a user within the team based on their user ID.

methods.name: getUserBudget
methods.description: Retrieves the maximum budget limit set for a user.

methods.name: getUserRateLimits
methods.description: Retrieves the rate limits (RPM and TPM) for a user, formatted as a combined string.
